name: @vssaros/dsh-codebase
description: VsSaros codebase-graph module for DeepSeek Harness: reads a code graph inside the Host process (IDE artifact <workspace>/.codebase-memory/, or its own shadow artifact) and exposes the codebase_* tools plus a read-only page. P0 (2026-10-12): lib/parser/ proves the Host (Node) can host tree-sitter in worker_threads. P1 (2026-10-12): lib/shadow.js + lib/indexService.js + codebase_index (approval-gated) write a shadow graph (regex-level: files + top-level symbols) into <indexDir>/codebase-index/<ws-hash>/, never into the workspace; the reader prefers it. P2 (2026-10-12): real tree-sitter parsing is IN — accurate symbols/line numbers plus CALLS/USAGE/INHERITS/IMPLEMENTS edges via parser: treesitter (P7, 2026-10-13: the default became `auto` — tree-sitter when the vendored assets are available, with an honest `degraded` report when they are not; the chosen tier AND the last measured build time land in index-meta.json). P3/P3-b/P4: full vendored wasm (16 grammars), freshness discipline (stale shadow yields to a newer IDE graph), indexWatch. Ownership: indexTarget: workspace writes <ws>/.codebase-memory/ behind the shared index.lock. Page (0.6.16+): sidebar summary + entry that opens the editor detail page, an editor page laid out like the original Codebase Memory pane (honest about what is NOT ported), and a read-only graph browser plus a shape-query subset (explicitly not Cypher). P6/P8/P9/P10/P11 (2026-10-13/14): 21 tools — coverage (set-difference only; explicitly NOT per-file reasons) / delete_project / export+import artifact (import is untrusted input: verify BEFORE writing, then read back) / text search (search_code + search_files; filesystem, no index needed) / manage_adr (ADRs live in the workspace .codebase-memory/adr) / a shape-query tool (the only gate that branches on the action) — plus PORT_AUDIT: all 18 upstream tools accounted for (16 mapped, 1 replaced-language, 1 written-up conclusion), and the page recomputes that audit instead of trusting a hardcoded list.
